candidates.change_summary: Replace the zeroing of rewardsForA[recipient] to occur after the external call, allowing reentrant behavior to observe different state after withdrawReward completes.
Remove setting _locked to true inside the modifier (so _locked never prevents reentrancy), changing post-call state of _locked and enabling different observable behavior.
Move the line that sets claimedBonus[recipient] = true to before the call to withdrawReward, so the bonus is marked claimed prior to withdrawal.
Remove the call to withdrawReward and instead mark bonus claimed and leave funds in rewardsForA (so no immediate withdrawal occurs).
Change the increment to rewardsForA to add 200 instead of 100, altering the stored reward amount after the call.
Set claimedBonus before modifying rewardsForA, so a reentrant call would see the bonus marked claimed but the reward not yet added.
After adding the reward, zero out rewardsForA before calling withdrawReward, preventing any funds being sent on withdrawal.
